mn61:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
mn61:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Rāhulo Ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ viharati.
mn61:2.2: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yen' Ambalaṭṭhikā yen' āyasmā Rāhulo ten' upasaṅkami.
mn61:2.3: Addasā kho āyasmā Rāhulo Bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ,
mn61:2.7: Āyasmā pi kho Rāhulo Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn61:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā parittaṃ udakāvasesaṃ udakādhāne ṭhapetvā āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ āmantesi:
mn61:3.2: Passasi no tvaṃ Rāhula imaṃ parittaṃ udakāvasesaṃ udakādhāne ṭhapitanti. --
mn61:3.4: Evaṃ parittaṃ kho Rāhula tesaṃ sāmaññaṃ yesaṃ na-tthi sampajānamusāvāde lajjā ti.
mn61:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā taṃ parittaṃ udakāvasesaṃ chaḍḍetvā āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ āmantesi:
mn61:4.2: Passasi no tvaṃ Rāhula taṃ parittaṃ udakāvasesaṃ chaḍḍitan-ti. --
mn61:4.4: -Evaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ kho Rāhula tesaṃ sāmaññaṃ yesaṃ natthi sampajānamusāvāde lajjā ti.
mn61:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā taṃ udakādhānaṃ nikujjitvā āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ āmantesi:
mn61:5.2: Passasi no tvaṃ Rāhula imaṃ udakādhānaṃ nikujjitan-ti. --
mn61:5.4: Evaṃ nikujjitaṃ kho Rāhula tesaṃ sāmaññaṃ yesaṃ na-tthi sampajānamusāvāde lajjā ti.
mn61:6.1: Atha kho Bhagavā taṃ udakādhānaṃ ukkujjitvā āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ āmantesi:
mn61:6.2: Passasi no tvaṃ Rāhula imaṃ udakādhānaṃ rittaṃ tucchan-ti. --
mn61:6.4: Evaṃ rittaṃ tucchaṃ kho Rāhula tesaṃ sāmaññaṃ yesaṃ na-tthi sampajānamusāvāde lajjā.
mn61:7.1: Seyyathā pi Rāhula rañño nāgo īsādanto ubbūḷhavā 'bhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro, so saṅgāmagato purimehi pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti pacchimehi pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, purimena pi kāyena kammaṃ karoti pacchimena pi kāyena kammaṃ karoti, sīsena pi kammaṃ karoti, kaṇṇehi pi kammaṃ karoti, dantehi pi kammaṃ karoti, naṅguṭṭhena pi kammaṃ karoti, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ rakkhat' eva soṇḍaṃ;
mn61:7.3: Ayaṃ kho rañño nāgo īsādanto ubbūḷhavā 'bhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti pacchimehi pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti purimena pi kāyena kammaṃ karoti pacchimena pi kāyena kammaṃ karoti, sīsena pi kammaṃ karoti, kaṇṇehi pi kammaṃ karoti, dantehi pi kammaṃ karoti, naṅguṭṭhena pi kammaṃ karoti, rakkhat' eva soṇḍaṃ;
mn61:7.5: Yato kho Rāhula rañño nāgo īsādanto ubbūḷhavā 'bhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro saṅgāmagato --pe-- naṅguṭṭhena pi kammaṃ karoti, soṇḍāya pi kammaṃ karoti; tattha hatthārohassa evaṃ hoti:
mn61:7.6: Ayaṃ kho rañño nāgo īsādanto ubbūḷhavā 'bhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro saṅgāmagato --pe-- naṅguṭṭhena pi kammaṃ karoti, soṇḍāya pi kammaṃ karoti;

mn61:7.9: Evam-eva kho Rāhula yassa kassaci sampajānamusāvāde na-tthi lajjā nāhan-tassa kiñci pāpaṃ akaraṇīyan-ti vadāmi.
mn61:7.10: Tasmātiha te Rāhula: hassā pi na musā bhaṇissāmīti
